findings.fix: Import TauCeti.Analysis.Fourier.AddCircle, define qVector/anisotropyCoeff on its harmonic and normalisation, and delete from the new Mathematics file every lemma that module already provides; if it genuinely lacks these lemmas or cannot be imported, state that in the PR description so the gap can be checked.
findings.issue: New extension file of Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.AddCircle (fourier_apply_add, fourier_apply_sub, integrable_fourier_comp, integrable_fourier_mul_conj_fourier) is built directly on Mathlib, while the roadmap requires the Q-vector and harmonic coefficients to follow the conventions of the upstream module TauCeti.Analysis.Fourier.AddCircle and to take their normalisation from it. The PR never imports TauCeti and does not say why that module is unusable, so the new file is a parallel API to the roadmap-prescribed upstream one.

summary: The Q-vector, two-particle correlation and anisotropy coefficient are new material with no Mathlib counterpart (fourierCoeff takes a function, charFun needs an inner product space), and the probability API is reused correctly. But the roadmap directs this exact construction to TauCeti.Analysis.Fourier.AddCircle, and the PR instead opens a parallel Mathlib-only extension file; two proof steps also re-derive located Mathlib lemmas. TauCeti is pinned in lake-manifest.json but absent from the review checkout, so its module could not be grepped here; that is a gap for the humans.
